$comment: Starter security.json from marin-app-template, built from marin-os/schemas/profiles/internal.json — the right default for a staff-only MarinOS app (most apps in the catalog today). If this app is public-facing, authenticated, or otherwise doesn't fit 'internal', see marin-digital-standards/security/profiles.md and swap in the matching profile file instead. No app-identity fields belong here (id/name/repo/owner) — those live in marin.yml. Update review.lastReviewed/owner and securityTxt.expires when this app is actually reviewed; the meta-delivered controls are emitted into index.html by scripts/sync-security-meta.py. This starter adds connect-src for the shell catalog and Updates requests and permits data: images for the existing favicon/Pico icons. Review these additions for the actual app and regenerate the meta block after any policy change.

contentTypeOptions.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

permissionsPolicy.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

frameProtection.notes: Requires a header (X-Frame-Options) or a directive meta-delivered CSP ignores (frame-ancestors); neither is available on GitHub Pages.

exceptions.reason: GitHub Pages cannot serve custom HTTP headers, and meta-delivered CSP ignores frame-ancestors.
exceptions.riskDescription: Update this once the app's actual risk is known — a low-stakes internal tool and one handling sensitive workflows don't carry the same risk here.

exceptions.reason: Both require a real HTTP response header, which GitHub Pages does not serve.
exceptions.riskDescription: Standing gap shared by every MarinOS app on this hosting stack. See marin-digital-standards/security/standard.md.
